item.title: Warmer, pixel-identical otherwise

turns.text: Make this photo slightly warmer in tone; everything else must stay pixel-identical: same person, framing, background.

item.tests: should be an ffmpeg colour filter at 0 credits; the MCP re-renders on the image model

turns.text: Make this photo slightly warmer in tone; everything else must stay pixel-identical: same person, framing, background.
turns.agent:
To keep everything else pixel-identical, this needs a **non-generative color adjustment**. The connected Magic Hour editor regenerates pixels, so I can’t guarantee your exact-preservation requirement with it.

In a photo editor, increase **Temperature/Warmth slightly**—about +3 to +5 on a −100 to +100 scale—and leave all other controls unchanged. Export as PNG to avoid additional JPEG compression changes.

I haven’t modified your photo.
